name: 빵집
prompt: Edit only the silhouette proportions of this flat bread pictogram. Retain exactly three simple short rounded diagonal transparent scoring slots in the center; shorten their length so the loaf still has a broad thick solid rim all around. Same uniform opaque dark teal fill, clean crisp smooth geometric edges, genuinely transparent background. Keep this an extremely simple single-color printed symbol. No rough print texture, grunge, shading, gradients, highlights, bevel, depth, glow, shadow, badge, frame, letters or background. Square image; center the symbol within the middle 70% of the canvas. Must be immediately readable at 24px. Doors themselves are TRANSPARENT cutouts, all structural lines solid dark teal and very thick. No ornamental cornice or inset panels.
